ImageDescription.value: On 12 June 2009 the University of Vienna conferred the degree "Doctor Theologiae honoris causa" on Desmond Tutu. The Faculty of Protestant Theology and Senate based the decision on Tutu's outstanding achievement in developing and establishing what can be called "ubuntu-theology", his manifestation of what became known as "public theology". By integrating the principles of the South African ubuntu philosphy with his theological thinking he made a major contribution beyond classical Liberation Theology.

Categories.value: February 2017 in Florida|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR|United States photographs taken on 2017-02-17|Demonstrations and protests against the first presidency of Donald Trump in Florida|Scanned with Kodak Pakon F135 Plus|Demonstrations and protests against the immigration policies of Donald Trump during his first presidency

ImageDescription.value:
the amazing woman in the graduation cap and gown saw me walking with a sign in my hand that said "fuck trump and pence" and offered me a ride to the anti-trump protest in downtown. on the way there, her, her partner and i were all talking and she told me her story. she is an immigrant that submitted her paperwork for citizenship over 7 years ago. she has been waiting all this time, and nothing has been done. she has been living here most of her life waiting for official citizenship, and explained that her life is on hold at the moment.

it turns out she was a head speaker at the protest. her speech was heartbreaking. she had finished college to become a nurse, she received her cap and gown in the mail, and two days later found out that because she is still not a full citizen, she is being denied her diploma until she can show proof that she is legal. she worked for years and came out with near perfect grades. and now she cannot move forward in her life even though she did everything she was supposed to do. she worked hard and already had job offers after graduation. she was supposed to move across the country to start her life. and now her future is on hold over some paper work lost in translation.

don't stop fighting.

Credit.value: AAA025A

Artist.value: myrockethasnobrakes from Tampa, Florida, United States
